name: sla-management
description: Design and manage customer support SLAs — service level agreements, ticket priority matrices, first response time targets, resolution time targets, escalation paths, business hours configuration, and SLA performance dashboards. Use when defining support SLAs, building tier-based service levels, designing escalation policies, or measuring SLA compliance. Triggers on: "SLA design", "support SLAs", "escalation path", "ticket priority matrix", "first response time", "SLA compliance".
